question: Why does the Online channel bring in so much more completed revenue than the Direct and Partner channels over 2024 and 2025?

sql_attempts.sql: SELECT o.channel, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS completed_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS completed_order_count, AVG(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS avg_line_value FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY o.channel ORDER BY completed_revenue DESC LIMIT 500

answer: The Online channel brings in more completed revenue (10,195,563.46) primarily because it has a significantly higher volume of completed orders (3,458) compared to Direct (2,366 orders yielding 7,106,104.93) and Partner (1,922 orders yielding 5,831,252.80), while all three channels maintain very similar average line values ranging from 1,185.54 to 1,197.87.
